brief:
Qatar's air defence chief held talks with his Saudi counterpart in Riyadh, the Middle East Eye reported. The meeting represents continued military and security engagement between the two Gulf nations following their 2021 diplomatic reconciliation, which ended a three-year blockade that had strained regional relations.

Israeli forces detained Ramallah Governor Laila Ghannam in the town of Sinjil on Thursday after she attended the funeral of a Palestinian teenager, according to the Wafa news agency. Soldiers prevented her from leaving the area following the funeral service.

title: Qatar air defence chief visits Saudi Arabia for talks
